messages:
Maya (Docs): i'm putting together a tiny PR to clarify tiered credits: header names, a quick express middleware, node/python/curl snippets, and a single grafana promql for the usage panel. planning to open in an hour.

Jun (DevEx): +1. make the snippets very short so we can paste into quickstart. also show fallback to old header names.

Arun (Eng): prod headers -> X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining / X-Redwood-Quota-Window. keep X-Quota-* fallback. quick middleware:```js
app.use((req,res,next)=>{const r=res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||res.getHeader('X-Quota-Remaining');req.quota={remaining:Number(r||0)};next()})
```

Maya (Docs): perfect. node snippet:```js
const r=await fetch(url,{headers});console.log('rem',r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||r.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining'))
```
python snippet:```py
r=requests.post(url,json=payload,headers=headers)
print(r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') or 0)
```
curl: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" $URL | grep -i X-Redwood-Quota

Ellen (Billing): when you mention downgrades, use cautious language: "typically a short grace period; enterprise agreements may differ" and link to billing playbook. add a one-line reconciliation tip: use billing exports + redwood_tokens_consumed_total.

Maya (Docs): noted and added. grafana promql (7d consumption by tier):```promql
sum by(customer_tier)(increase(redwood_tokens_consumed_total{env="prod",customer_type!~"internal|test"}[7d]))
```
Legend: {{customer_tier}}

DocsBot: PR checklist: changelog entry + migration note + billing crosslink.

Maya (Docs): i'll open PR at 1758301500 and tag @Jun, @Arun, @Ellen for review. thanks! :sparkles:
